verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents automations as multi-step workflows with triggers on events or segment entry, goals, exit criteria, and chained delays via Wait Until blocks. A community user confirms building strong workflows. Branching logic is never explicitly documented, so coverage is incomplete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional branches/splits, and lifecycle-specific examples (onboarding, winback) with independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: An automation is a workflow to send messages and manipulate data in Customer.io.
It consists of four major components: Trigger... Goals... Exit criteria... Workflows
Chain multiple delays together in a single _Wait Until_ block
You can trigger automations when profiles perform events, when they join Segments (e.g. they meet attribute conditions), and so on.
With a good analytics plan you could build strong workflows.
